ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Suddenly understood at the words is a biographical event formula marking the precise turn in an encounter when a named participant recognizes something upon hearing the preceding words.
EvidenceBody: Speech is recorded as an event-boundary: the formula links the quoted exchange to the participant’s sudden recognition without explaining an inner conclusion.
This is compiler narration, not a quotation uttered by the person who awakened; MasterName therefore remains null and the named figure is the narrative subject.
Yunyan, Zongxian, and Yangshan are different subjects of the same narrated event type, not master-specific senses.
